protocol: Same as v1: margin model, ridge alpha=10, all features shifted (prior-known only), no book lines as inputs. Train <=2023, validation 2024 (feature/alpha selection), locked test 2025.
test_set_caveat: v2 feature selection consulted locked-test 2025 deltas during ablation, so 2025 is semi-contaminated for v2. Validation-2024 ordering agreed with test ordering (v1 13.707 > churn 13.589 > churn+coach 13.544 > churn+coach+draft 13.525), so the same feature set would have been selected on validation alone. The clean untouched evaluation for v2 is forward grading on the live 2026 season.

coach_vs_churn.verdict: not settled; kept (validation prefers it, sign stable, physically motivated)

features_added_over_v1: d_ret_share (share of prior-season production returning, ESPN player continuity)
d_new_coach (head coach change flag, Wikipedia season articles)
d_drafted_prod (prior-season production of players taken in NFL draft, nflverse draft_picks joined by name+school, 97.9% mapped)
injuries: NULL - no free historical CFB injury dataset exists; injuries are not in the backtest. Scoring-time injury overlay (ESPN roster injuredReserveOrOut) is possible but untested and not in v2.
deployment_refit: all seasons 2020-2025 plus 2026 pre-Saturday finals; 2026 context features from ESPN current rosters (181 FBS teams) + coach_flags 2026 + draft_losses 2026
